bias_controls: All 32 seeds are fixed in this specification before execution.
Every declared seed is reported; no seed may be discarded or selected as representative.
The base experiment is bound by a canonical content digest.
Acceptance thresholds are fixed before any multi-seed result is generated.
The strategy, split, costs, and original per-seed decision rule remain unchanged.
failure_modes: Multiple seeds explore sampling variability but do not create independent real market regimes.
The same deliberately simplified AR(1) process is used for every seed.
The Wilson interval treats seed outcomes as Bernoulli trials and does not repair model misspecification.
Passing this gate remains evidence about research infrastructure, not tradable alpha.
hypothesis: The unchanged EXP-0001 rule will pass on at least 90% of 32 preregistered seeds, and the two-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound for its seed-level pass probability will be at least 80%.
next_experiment: Introduce a negative control with no injected autocorrelation and require the multi-seed gate to reject it before considering any real market dataset.
title: Preregistered multi-seed sensitivity gate
